JOB Description – NPD Scientist
Client-Facing Product Development & Tech-Commercial Execution
Leumas · Bengaluru
Leumas is seeking an NPD (New Product Development) Scientist to lead client-facing product development engagements and drive technical-commercial alignment across nutraceutical and healthcare manufacturing programs.
This role is responsible for interfacing directly with clients to understand, structure, and translate product requirements into executable development plans, while ensuring alignment with manufacturing feasibility, regulatory considerations, and commercial objectives. The position requires a strong ability to operate at the intersection of customer engagement, scientific understanding, and execution discipline.

About Leumas
Leumas is a Bangalore-based deep-tech manufacturing company building a software-defined production platform for healthcare manufacturing. Its proprietary, full-stack Manufacturing Operating System orchestrates the entire manufacturing lifecycle - from formulation logic and material flow to production execution, quality control, and traceability - enabling modular, reconfigurable factories that scale with demand.
Leumas addresses structural challenges in global supply chains, rigidity, long lead times, and capital intensive, step function scale - through a modular, distributed manufacturing architecture that enables faster deployment, higher asset utilization, and materially improved business outcomes across product life cycle Leumas supports two primary deployment models. For enterprise customers, it enables dedicated manufacturing suites that provide high levels of supply chain control, compliance, and flexibility without the burden of traditional greenfield capex or non-resilient supply chains from traditional CDMOs.
For healthcare innovators, the platform allows rapid configuration of production lines through software, enabling faster product launches, tighter quality control, and responsive scale-up or scale down.
Leumas’ production systems currently support more than a dozen finished formulations and consumer health formats, including semi-solids (ointments, gels, lotions), oral solid dosage forms (tablets, capsules), and liquid formulations, with integrated QA and inspection capabilities.

The Role
As NPD Scientist, you will serve as the primary technical interface for clients during the product development lifecycle, owning the clarity, completeness, and alignment of all customer inputs.
You will work closely with Business Development, R&D, and Operations teams to ensure that client expectations are accurately interpreted, technically validated, and translated into structured execution plans.
The role requires a high degree of ownership in managing client interactions, aligning cross-functional teams, and ensuring that product development outcomes are consistent with both customer intent and operational realities.

What You Will Own
1. Client-Facing Technical Engagement (Primary Ownership)
• Lead structured technical discussions with clients to understand product intent, target outcomes, and positioning.
• Capture detailed inputs across formulation expectations, dosage formats, ingredient preferences, claims, packaging, and scale requirements.
• Identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks in client inputs, and proactively drive clarity.
• Act as the single point of technical ownership during client interactions in the development phase.
• Manage client expectations with respect to feasibility, timelines, and development scope.
2. Requirement Structuring & Internal Translation
• Translate client discussions into comprehensive and structured technical briefs for internal teams.
• Define clear scope, assumptions, constraints, and execution parameters.
• Ensure alignment of all stakeholders on product requirements before initiation of development.
• Maintain consistency between client communication and internal execution plans.
3. Commercial & Feasibility Alignment
• Work closely with Business Development teams to align customer requirements with cost structures, timelines, and operational constraints.
• Provide technical inputs for pricing, feasibility assessments, and proposal development.
• Support client discussions involving trade-offs between cost, performance, and manufacturability.
• Ensure commitments made to clients are realistic and executable.
4. Client Communication & Relationship Management
• Act as a key technical stakeholder in client calls, presentations, and follow-ups.
• Communicate progress, challenges, and changes in a clear and professional manner.
• Build credibility and trust with clients through structured and informed engagement.
• Support onboarding of clients from discussion stage into execution readiness.
5. Product Development & Formulation Support
• Support formulation development across dosage forms such as capsules, tablets, powders, and blends.
• Guide selection of actives, excipients, and delivery mechanisms based on defined requirements.
• Assist in trials, optimization, and scale-up activities as required.
6. Documentation & Execution Readiness
• Maintain structured records of client requirements, discussions, and decisions.
• Ensure traceability between client inputs, formulation outputs, and execution plans.
• Support preparation of technical documentation, dossiers, and validation records.
• Enable audit-ready documentation across development stages.
